preconditions.description: The root of the binary tree must not be None.
The number of nodes in the binary tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in nodes)
preconditions.description: The data of each node in the binary tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The length of the returned list must equal the number of nodes in the binary tree.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == nodes[i].val for i in range(len(nodes)))
postconditions.description: The returned list must contain the values of the nodes in preorder traversal order.
